name: fanbar
title: FanBar
description: Switch FanBar cooling presets, set a fixed fan speed, and watch fans and temperatures on your Mac.
author: JarinHe

commands.name: switch-preset
commands.title: Switch Preset
commands.subtitle: FanBar
commands.description: Run a built-in or custom cooling preset's curve.

commands.name: fan-status
commands.title: Fan Status
commands.subtitle: FanBar
commands.description: Show FanBar's mode, fan speeds and temperatures.

commands.name: fixed-rpm
commands.title: Fixed RPM
commands.subtitle: FanBar
commands.description: Hold every fan at a fixed speed.

commands.name: automatic
commands.title: Automatic
commands.subtitle: FanBar
commands.description: Hand the fans back to macOS.

commands.name: menu-bar
commands.title: FanBar Menu Bar
commands.subtitle: FanBar
commands.description: CPU temperature in the menu bar, with preset switching. Never starts a FanBar you quit.

preferences.name: fanbarPath
preferences.title: fanbar Path
preferences.description: Full path to the fanbar tool. Leave empty to look in /usr/local/bin, /opt/homebrew/bin and /Applications/FanBar.app.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
